findings.note: CNHI report of his announcement (the article says Thursday; the Patch story on the same event is dated 2025-01-09). Only the phrase in quotation marks is his own wording; the rest is the reporter's summary.

S.1671 'An Act relative to firearm laws': petition by Durant (with three co-petitioners) for legislation to repeal the firearms laws. Docket filed 1/13/2025. Referred to Public Safety and Homeland Security; later accompanied a study order.
S.1677 'An Act relative to semiautomatic rifles and shotguns': petition by Durant for legislation relative to firearm identification card. Referred to Public Safety and Homeland Security.
S.1672 'An Act relative to registration of guns': petition by Durant for legislation relative to registration of guns. Referred to Public Safety and Homeland Security.
